metadata.title: $h$-cobordisms between $1$-connected manifolds with boundary
metadata.abstract: We classify $h$-cobordisms between compact simply-connected $4$-manifolds with boundary in both the smooth and topological categories. This extends a result of Kreck, which proved the corresponding result for closed manifolds. As an application, we recover the injectivity portion of Orson-Powell's computation of the mapping class group for simply-connected topological $4$-manifolds with boundary.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 带边界单连通四维流形的 h 配边分类
analysis.workSummary: 在光滑与拓扑两个范畴中分类紧致单连通四维带边界流形之间的 h 配边，把 Kreck 对闭流形的对应结果推广到带边界情形。作为应用，重新获得 Orson–Powell 关于单连通拓扑四维带边界流形映射类群计算中的单射性部分。
analysis.breakthrough: 将闭流形分类推进到边界存在时的相对问题，并关联已知映射类群结果。
analysis.limitations: 仅依据官方英文摘要解读，尚未核读数学正文。摘要未列出边界标记、相对等价关系及分类数据，不能理解为任意此类 h 配边都平凡。
analysis.priorityReason: 带边界四维分类是重要技术环节，适合关注配边及映射类群的读者优先核读。
